version: FW1 R1 off-source-only finite-statistic screen, before strain exposure
sky_time: CO2 fixed nominal GCN query at GPS1187008882.43; not certified event astrometry/rotating response
heldout_detector_normalization: b_V=1; one contrast, not three independent tests
alignment: 98s cyclic real Fourier shifts exp(+2pi i f tau), DC and Nyquist set zero; crop4s on each side, then null row, then periodic Hann90s, then Fourier band projection

PSD.method: mean of12 Welch estimates of aligned residual cores

statistic: mean one-sided Hann-periodogram/PSD over retained90s Fourier bins
reference_threshold: strictly greater than maximum of21 unchanged reference statistics
effect_unit: residual root-sum-square strain over90s core, strain sqrt(second), before Hann weighting
rng: NumPy Generator(PCG64(352170817+1000*family_index+phase_index)), indices0-based; draw all active-bin real standard_normals first, then all imaginary standard_normals; all other bins0; NumPy2.2.6
hrss_normalization: sqrt(sum(cropped90s samples squared)/4096); normalize each padded inverse-rFFT waveform by this scalar; effect is before Hann
injection_generation: independent complex standard-normal98s Fourier coefficients within each band; irfft; normalize cropped90s discrete L2; additive residual via V channel only, inverse cyclic delay; no source-mechanism claim
screen_survival_rule: at least90percent of21x8 fixed background/phase combinations cross reference maximum at target in EACH family
power_scope: finite in-sample reinjection fraction, NOT population power/confidence; full curves retained
failure_meaning: chosen finite statistic fails supplied resolution query; no bound on all other tests or on physical GW170817 departures
successful_screen_meaning: only motivation to resolve remaining full-operator/error gate; no event unseal
stationarity_diagnostic: chronological reference halves medians and max/min; report, do not adapt or delete outcomes
method_checks: saved CO2 hash and bF original residual
two independent arbitrary Fourier tensor functions cancel in declared cyclic static model
wrong alignment sign and wrong heldout coefficient actually fail
quadratic reinjection formula agrees with direct recomputation
PSD positivity and no nonfinite samples
numeric_guard: work with strain multiplied by1e21; residual/error norms divided by nonzero input-network/reference norm; no absolute1e-10 strain test. Require wrong-sign and omitted-H coefficient controls to exceed1e-3 relative error
PSD_validity: before flooring require finite positive retained/interpolated PSD; report count below floor and stop inconclusive if any retained floor activates; do not manufacture precision by clipping
response_and_calibration_policy: no median correction or nuisance fit; archives summarized separately; finite-arm/rotation/calibration/upstream deviations not certified by screen
maximum_claim: reviewed off-source empirical sensitivity of precisely declared finite surrogate only
